summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $1.27B in SPXW 5000C (April 2026) and $668M in SPX 6000C (August 2026) accumulations. Significant directional conviction is visible in the persistent, multi-day accumulation of SPX 6000C strikes across 2026 and 2027 expirations, totaling billions in premium. While heavy put buying exists in the 8000-8100 strike range for 2026, the sheer scale of the 5000C and 6000C call clusters suggests a massive long-term structural hedge or leveraged beta play. Traders should watch for volatility in SPX and NDXP, as the extreme low P/C ratios in NDXP (0.17) and MU (0.28) indicate aggressive, concentrated call buying that could lead to rapid gamma squeezes if underlying price action follows.
